items.t: Engine stalls from failing fuel pump (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair: replace fuel pump
items.note: Free at a Lexus dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump can crack and leak fuel (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair: replace high-pressure fuel pumps
items.note: Free at a Lexus dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.job: Dealer recall repair: replace tire label
items.note: Free at a Lexus dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant
items.note: RepairPal lists about $847-$1,130 for the RC 350. The RC F's V8 can cost more.

items.t: Hard starting with lean check engine codes
items.job: Diagnose fuel pressure; replace low-pressure fuel pump if needed
items.note: RepairPal lists about $879-$1,348 for an RC 350 fuel pump. Free if your car's fuel pump recall is still open.
RepairPal lists about $318-$450 depending on year. Ask whether the bulletin's revised pads apply.

items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors
items.note: Pads alone are about $318-$450 at RepairPal; rotors add parts. RC F carbon-ceramic or large F brakes cost more.

items.t: A/C blows the wrong temperature or from the wrong vents
items.note: May be free under Lexus program 20LE01 if your car still qualifies.

items.t: Check engine light with idle or throttle codes on the V8
items.job: Replace throttle body and ventilation hoses
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,114-$1,553 for an RC 350 throttle body; RC F parts may cost more.

items.t: Check engine light with oxygen sensor code P013A
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,243-$1,495 for an RC 350 oxygen sensor. Check the bulletin first; a software fix may be enough.

items.t: 12-volt battery runs down when the car sits
items.note: RepairPal lists about $839-$867 for an RC 350 battery. A battery that only ran down from sitting may just need a full recharge.

items.t: Car pulls or drifts after tires are swapped around
items.job: Wheel alignment and tire position check
items.note: RepairPal lists about $195-$286 for an RC 350 alignment.

items.t: Navigation freezes, reboots or the screen acts up
items.job: Multimedia software update at a Lexus dealer
items.note: If the update doesn't help, a head unit replacement costs much more.

items.t: Bluetooth phone won't pair or keeps dropping
items.note: Re-pairing the phone yourself costs nothing and often fixes it.

items.t: Apple CarPlay drops out or the screen goes black
Remote app and connected services stop working
items.note: A replacement telematics module adds parts.

items.t: Musty or sour smell from the A/C
items.note: Fixing any water leak that caused it costs extra.

items.t: Water in the trunk from rear wheel arch sealer
items.job: Reseal rear wheel arch under Lexus campaign
items.note: Free under the Lexus campaign if your VIN is included.

items.t: Check engine light with code P2610
